verdict.rationale: Maritime is a cloud platform that hosts agents and their data, so data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no retention policies, retention windows, or data-deletion controls. The Files API covers browse, upload, download, and edit of an agent's disk but never mentions deletion or retention. Encrypted-at-rest secrets are an adjacent security control, not retention control, and session logs are described as append-only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
